==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*If activated, Pressurized Magazine will display an icon timer beside the player's health UI, and the Warframe will be briefly surrounded by a flashing energy ribbon.
*The Fire Rate bonus is granted upon the end of the reload animation.
*On event launch, Pressurized Magazine's duration was not only affected by rank, but also by the amount of [[Fusion]] energy in each rank.
*Can be combined with {{M|Gunslinger}}, {{M|Lethal Torrent}}, {{M|Anemic Agility}} and {{Arcane|Arcane Velocity}} for a total of +'''432%''' fire rate while aiming. This used on the Twin Grakatas will result in a fire rate of almost '''173''' rounds per second, making it possible to empty its entire 120-round magazine in '''0.35''' seconds.

==Tips==
* The fire rate buff is activated on the animation start which can be interrupted with a quick melee, meaning the buff can be activated almost on demand for high magazine/low fire rate weapons.

==Bugs==
*If Pressurized Magazine is installed on the currently equipped pistol, reloading a primary weapon during a mission will display the flash effect associated with the mod's activation, though the weapon will not gain the fire rate bonus.

'''Primary Deadhead''' is a [[Arcane Enhancement#Primary_Weapon_Arcanes|Primary Arcane]] that on weak point kill increases primary weapon damage for 24 seconds and stacks up to 3 times. At max rank, it also passively increases [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot damage multiplier]] and reduces [[recoil]].

Can be sold for {{cc|1,000}}.

==Effect==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Arcane Enhancement#Rank|Rank]]
! Damage per Stack
! Total at 3 stacks
! Headshot Multiplier
! Recoil
|-
| 0 || 20% || 60% || - || -
|-
| 1 || 40% || 120% || - || -
|-
| 2 || 60% || 180% || - || -
|-
| 3 || 80% || 240% || - || -
|-
| 4 || 100% || 300% || - || -
|-
| 5 || 120% || 360% || +30% || -50%
|}

{{Acquisition|Awarded for defeating [[Acolytes]] in [[The Steel Path]].}}

==Notes==
*The damage bonus stacks additively with other damage mods like {{M|Serration}}.
*When the buff times out, one stack is lost and the buff duration resets.
*Headshot bonus stacks additively with {{M|Target Acquired}}, innate headshot damage bonuses on weapons such as {{Weapon|Kuva Chakkhurr}}, and snipers with bonus headshot damage from scope bonuses.
**{{Weapon|Cernos Prime}}'s headshot bonus is unique and stacks multiplicatively with Primary Deadhead's headshot bonus.
*Kills from some status procs on the target's weak point do '''not''' count as a weak point kill.
**{{D|Electricity}} and {{D|Gas}} procs are able to trigger the effect when aimed at the head however, as they are able to land headshots themselves.
*'Precision' refers to direct hit weak points (not AoE).

==Tips==
*Can be used on weapons which normally have a 1.0x multiplier to headshots (such as the {{Weapon|Arca Plasmor}}/{{Weapon|Tenet Arca Plasmor}} and [[Update 32]] launchers such as the {{Weapon|Kuva Zarr}} and {{Weapon|Afentis}}) to give them a 1.3x headshot multiplier and actually provide a benefit.
*Since Electricity and Gas procs are able to independently land headshots, they benefit twice from the headshot multiplier bonus. Both of these procs will have 1.69x headshot damage from the bonus.

'''Primary Blight''' is an [[Arcane Enhancement]] for [[Primary Weapon]]s that provides [[Critical Hit|Critical Damage]] and [[Multishot]] when the equipped weapon applies a {{D|Toxin}} status effect.

==Effect==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Arcane Enhancement#Rank|Rank]] !! Critical Damage per Stack !! Max Critical Damage Stack !! Multishot per Stack !! Max Multishot Stack
|-
| 0 || 0.6% || 24% || 0.3% || 12%
|-
| 1 || 1.2% || 48% || 0.6% || 24%
|-
| 2 || 1.8% || 72% || 0.9% || 36%
|-
| 3 || 2.4% || 96% || 1.2% || 48%
|-
| 4 || 3% || 120% || 1.5% || 60%
|-
| 5 || 3.6% || 144% || 1.8% || 72%
|}

{{Acquisition|
*May be sold by [[Acrithis]] for 10 {{Resource|Pathos Clamp}} on a daily rotational basis, requiring [[Drifter/Intrinsics|Drifter Intrinsics]] [[Drifter/Intrinsics/Opportunity|Opportunity]] Rank 9 for the arcanes to appear in her shop.
*This Arcane can be acquired from [[Duviri]]'s [[The Circuit/Rewards/SteelPathTiers|Circuit Steel Path]], or random rewards from [[Undercroft]] optional portals.
*Possible reward from [[Bounty#Deepmines Bounties|Deepmines Bounties]] from [[Nightcap]].
*Purchaseable from [[Nightcap]] in [[Fortuna]] for 10 {{Resource|Fergolyte}} each, with a total of 210 for max rank.}}

==Notes==
* At all ranks, it will take '''40'''  {{D|Toxin}} procs to reach the maximum bonus.
** Unlike ''all'' other weapon arcanes that trigger from [[status effects]], stacking the Blight buff '''requires the {{D|Toxin}} proc to be inflicted by using the attached primary weapon'''. 
***Effects that add {{D|Toxin}} element to the primary weapon, such as {{WF|Saryn}}'s {{A|Toxic Lash}} and {{WF|Oraxia}}'s {{A|Silken Stride}} can modify the elemental makeup of the weapon's damage, but casting an ability cannot stack the Blight buff.
***Secondary weapons, Melee weapons, and abilities and weapons used by Companions are also not capable of triggering the Blight buff.
*Though some enemies have a capped number of status effects they can receive, such as [[Bosses]] and [[Adversary System|Adversaries]], applying a {{D|Toxin}} proc to an enemy at max procs will still cause Primary Blight to refresh and stack.
*Stacks are granted and refreshed even on fatal damage instances that apply {{D|Toxin}}.  
*If Primary Blight is equipped on multiple weapons simultaneously, as is possible with [[Exalted Weapons]] and [[Archgun|Archguns]], they will all share the same buff.
* If the '''12''' second timer expires without applying a fresh {{D|Toxin}} status effect, all stacks are removed.
** This behavior is consistent with other weapon arcanes that trigger on status effect application, like {{Arcane|Primary Frostbite}} and {{Arcane|Cascadia Flare}}.
** This is distinct from weapon arcanes that trigger on kill, like {{Arcane|Primary Merciless}} and {{Arcane|Primary Deadhead}}, where timer expiration causes only one stack to be removed at a time. 
*{{Arcane|Primary Frostbite}}, a primary weapon arcane with similar effects except triggered by {{D|Cold}}, can be compared to Blight, and both weapon arcanes yield very effective damage boosts with only slight differences.
**{{Arcane|Primary Blight}}, triggering from {{D|Toxin}}, offers a maximum 144% Critical Damage and 72% Multishot, prioritizing [[Critical Damage]].
**{{Arcane|Primary Frostbite}}, triggering on {{D|Cold}}, offers a maximum 120% Critical Damage and 90% Multishot, prioritizing [[Multishot]].
***However, {{Arcane|Primary Frostbite}} has advantages over {{Arcane|Primary Blight}}, since the Frostbite buff can be stacked with {{D|Cold}} status effects from any source, whereas {{Arcane|Primary Blight}} can only be stacked from primary weapon {{D|Toxin}} status effects.

'''Primary Acuity''' is a [[mod]] that increases the [[Enemy Body Parts|Weak Point]] Damage and Weak Point [[Critical Chance]] of rifles, but prevents [[Multishot]] from being modified.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! Weak Point Damage
! Weak Point Critical Chance
! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 
| +32%|| +32% || 6
|-
| 1 
| +64%|| +64% || 7
|-
| 2 
| +95%|| +95% || 8
|-
| 3 
| +127%|| +127% || 9
|-

| +159%|| +159% || 10
|-

| +223%|| +223% || 12

|-

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*Equipping this mod will set weapon's [[Multishot]] to its default ignoring other bonuses, '''even negative effects''' (e.g. {{M|Rifle Riven Mod}}).
*The Weak Point Damage bonus works by increasing the [[Enemy Body Parts|Weak Point Multiplier]] (usually 3x, 1.5x, or 1x) on weak point hits. Increases to the Weak Point Multiplier are applied at 1.0x rate on non-headshot weakpoints, and at an increased rate of 1.5x when a weakpoint is also a headshot.
**For example, a typical humanoid enemy such as a {{E|Butcher}} has a 3x Weak Point Multiplier on its head. A rank 10 Acuity will increase this value to ''3 + 1.5 * (3.5) = 8.25x'' 
***This is a relative damage increase of '''+175%'''
**Acuity applies at 1.5x on most natural weak points, since most weakpoints are also heads.
**Acuity applies at 1.0x on the weak points of {{E|The Severed Warden}}, {{E|Lumbering Fragment}} and {{E|Scaldra Harbinger}}, all {{E|Isolator Bursa|Bursa}} rear panels, and rears of most {{E|MOA}} variants (but excluding Anti, Fusion, and Disc).
***Body parts highlighted by {{WF|Banshee}}'s {{A|Sonar}} count as weak points, and use the original multiplier and headshot/bodyshot criteria of the highlighted part, most frequently a bodyshot location, resulting in Acuity applying at 1.0x.
*When multiple sources of bonus Weak Point Damage are present (e.g., {{A|Seek}}), the same 1.0x or 1.5x applies to all of them, and they are added to the weakpoint multiplier.
**Ex: a 3x headshot weakpoint with Primary Acuity and Seek would have a multiplier of: ''3 + 1.5 * (3.5 + 0.75) = 9.375x''
***If the same shot were made to a non-headshot 3x weak point, the multiplier would be: ''3 + 1.0 * (3.5 + 0.75) = 7.25x''
*Note that damage increase may vary between different types of enemies, since not all enemies will receive [[Critical_Hit#Critical_Headshots|"Headcrit"]] damage. Headcrit applies to a narrower category of body parts than 'headshot' or 'weakpoint', for example excluding robotic {{E|MOA}} heads and {{E|The Hollow Vein}}'s serpentine head. 
*Weapons with [[Area of Effect]] damage or [[Enemy_Body_Parts#Notes|other special projectiles]] that inherently do not deal increased weakpoint damage will '''not''' gain increased damage from this mod.
*The Weak Point Multiplier is multiplicative with bonuses to Headshot Multiplier, such as from {{Arcane|Primary Deadhead}}.  
**For example, equipping both Primary Acuity and Primary Deadhead and hitting a 3x weakpoint yields a ''1.3*(3+1.5*(3.5))=10.725x'' multiplier. 
*The bonus [[Critical Chance]] stacks additively with other mods like {{M|Point Strike}}.
*Weakspots created by {{WF|Citrine}}'s {{A|Crystallize}} do '''not''' count as weak points.

==Tips==
*Perhaps counter-intuitively, Acuity has the greatest effect when planning to target head weakpoints that have a multiplier of 1x, such as {{E|Infested Oni}}. Since it raises the value of that weakpoint from 1x to ''1 + 1.5 * (3.5) = 6.25x'', it increases damage output by 525% damage.
**For non-headshot weak points, a 1x location is raised to 4.5x, an effective damage increase of 350%. 
**In comparison, Acuity raises the value of a 3x head weakpoint to 8.25x, resulting in a 175% effective increase. This is comparable to bonus from {{M|Galvanized Chamber}} which results in a 230% increase at max stacks.
*Acuity is also very effective when a body part highlighted by Banshee's {{A|Sonar}} has a part multiplier below 1.
**Ex: shooting at the carapace plating of {{E|Deimos Charger}}, a 0.05x weakpoint when highlighted by {{A|Sonar}}:
*** 5 * 0.05 = 0.25x
**The above, but with Acuity:
*** 5 * (0.05 + 3.5) = 17.75x

==Bugs==

==See Also==
*{{M|Pistol Acuity}}, the secondary variant.

'''Primary Debilitate''' is an [[Arcane_Enhancement#Primary_Weapon_Arcanes|Primary Arcane]] that applies additional status effects when a [[Damage#Possible_Combinations|Combined Element]] status is at 10 stacks or more.

==Acquisition==
*Can be bought from [[Roathe]] at [[La Cathédrale]] in the [[Sanctum Anatomica]] for 5 {{Resource|Maphica}}.
*May appear as a [[Steel Path]] [[The Descendia]] reward on a weekly rotational basis.
**Infernum 6 and 13 awards 1.
**Infernum 20 awards 3.

==Notes==
* The extra [[Status Effect]] created by this arcane is applied as a separate damage instance, causing [[Faction Damage Bonus|Faction Damage Bonuses]] to multiply the [[Damage over Time]] effect of {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Electricity}}, and {{D|Toxin}} status three separate times.
* This arcane will only activate once per damage instance, making it less effective than it "should" be when used on a Beam weapon, due to how [[Multishot]] affects such weapons. 
* Will apply status effects from any source of combined elemental damage buffs, such as {{M|Gastroparesis}} allowing both the Heat and Poison status to scale infinitely.
* This ''can'' add Cold and Heat procs from a full stack of {{D|Blast}} status effects, but it triggers less often due to the 10 stack loss of blast, and is less effective than Gas or Corrosive since Cold status deals no DoT.

==Notes==
*The bonuses smoothly scale between whole number radius values. For example, a loss of 6.5 meters of radius gives +650% Damage and +35.75% Ammo Efficiency with a Rank 5 arcane.
*On projectile weapons, the damage bonus is multiplicative to other damage bonus sources (e.g. {{M|Serration}}).
*Does not work on [[Continuous Weapon|Continuous Weapons]] or beam attacks with an AoE component, e.g. {{Weapon|Ignis}} or {{Weapon|Torid}}'s Incarnon Form.
*Ammo Efficiency is always granted based on radius lost, regardless of how the damage bonus functions. This includes [[Archgun|Archguns]], most of which currently gain no damage bonus or radius reduction, but do gain the Efficiency.
